sloka: कच्चिदाशास्ति देवानां प्रसादं पार्थिवात्मजः ।कच्चित् पुरुषकारं च दैवं च प्रतिपद्यते ।। ५.३६.१९।।।।
transliteration: kaccidāśāsti devānāṁ prasādaṁ pārthivātmajaḥ ।kaccit puruṣakāraṁ ca daivaṁ ca pratipadyate ।। 5.36.19।।।।

translations.english: "Does the prince ever seek the blessings of gods or fall back upon personal effort as well as providence?
